_comment: Web-play demo manifest (docs/PLAN-webui-demo-fbf243.md §5). COPY (labels, order, matchups, sims, blurbs, source detail) is hand-authored and reviewed in git; the identity guards (gameType/boardWidth/boardHeight/winLength) plus bytes/rawBytes/sha256/model/source.canonical are STAMPED by scripts/build-demo-bundle.sh from web/demo/curation-pins.json + the built models. Re-running the build never clobbers copy.

games.label: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.blurb: 30M-cycle NEAT champion. Tic-Tac-Toe is solved, so it plays perfectly — draw it if you can.

source.detail: Solved game, BvH trivially saturated (no ttt-*-sweep.csv). Pinned champion the dev app ships; documented BvH exception (§3.1). NEAT_POPULATION v4 — neatMember pins the champion member post-load. No heuristic opponent (supportsHeuristic:false).

games.label: Connect 4
games.blurb: AlphaZero-lite Connect 4 CNN, trained by self-play only. Against a perfect solver that plays a random move one time in ten, it scores 97% moving first and 63% moving second.

source.detail: Pre-registered pick 2026-10-05 (docs/BRIEF-connect4-noisy-solver.md sections 5.2 and 6.1): 6x64 CNN, seed 12 at 275,000 self-play games. Against the Pons solver with 10% random moves at 800 sims (seeds 2001-2700, both colours): score 0.973 first, 0.633 second, +0.051 [+0.031, +0.071] over the previous pin seed11-g275000. Net first against the perfect solver: 41 W / 6 D / 3 L.

games.label: Othello
games.blurb: 7x64 AlphaZero-lite Othello net: the ship-certified champion plus a second online generation (0.68 score vs Edax L10 at 12,800 sims; deployed by judgment on an inconclusive certification).

source.detail: BvH saturated for Othello (net beats the ply-8 Strong heuristic) -> ranked on the Edax ladder. C5 Arm A (docs/BRIEF-c5-gen2-capacity.md), DEPLOYED BY POLICY OVERRIDE 2026-09-06 (docs/HANDOFF-othello-program.md section 6): NOT certified. Its one-shot ship read on the held-out 800-opening C5 slice, L9/L10 @ sims=12800, opening-clustered paired bootstrap against the certified champion othello-c15-seed11 -> pooled +0.037 score [+0.0216, +0.0527] at 95%: INCONCLUSIVE (CI excludes zero, lower bound below the S=0.025 bar); dev L6-L8 +0.047 [+0.034, +0.059] IMPROVES. The 0.68 shown is a DESCRIPTIVE L10 read (256/32/112, n=400, spent dev-select-topup slice, eval seed 5, cpuct 2.5; the champion scored 0.6425 on the same cells in C4). Do NOT bundle othello-az-cnn7x64-edaxopp-L6 (~207MB, weaker).
source.evalConfig: level=10,sims=12800,openings=dev-select-topup(200 x 2 sides),seed=5; descriptive, not a ship read

games.label: Hex
games.blurb: cnn5x48 AlphaZero-lite on tournament-standard 11x11 Hex (99.5% vs the built-in heuristic).

source.detail: BvH champion==bvh row, 11x11, saves/hex-alphazero-11x11-rc500k-ep100-cnn5x48-sweep.csv. ALPHAZERO_CNN. Ships REPLAY-BUFFER-STRIPPED: 280MB canonical -> ~36MB raw / ~11.4MB zst (§3.1). Size-viable non-CNN 11x11 nets are unusable (1.5% BvH).

games.label: Gomoku
games.blurb: AlphaZero-lite 8x96 CNN on 13x13 freestyle Gomoku (five in a row), trained by population self-play. Against the TSS heuristic playing its best move it wins 96% of games, and against the Rapfi engine held to 64 nodes a move it scores 48%.
games.notice: This 13x13 net searches 3,200 positions a move. That takes a few seconds on a desktop and longer on laptops and phones, or half a minute or more where the browser runs the search on one thread.

source.detail: Operator pin 2026-10-06 (docs/BRIEF-gomoku-rapfi-read.md section 10.3), outside the read's section 5 rule: its condition 4 (a 3,200-sim move under 2 s on 8 workers) failed at about 4.3 s, and the operator chose to keep 3,200 sims and let move time vary by device. PBT champion of the 13x13 cnn8x96 run (slot 7 at 167,300 cycles), EMA weights, cpuct 2.5, exported from the champion sidecar; the save's 'cycles 31400' header comes from the template save, so bundledCycles is pinned. Read at 3,200 sims over 200 openings, both colours (section 10): against argmax TSS 0.963 [0.943, 0.980] at ply 3 and 0.960 [0.940, 0.978] at ply 4; against Rapfi 0.761 at 16 nodes a move, 0.482 at 64 and 0.310 at 256. The previous pin saves/gomoku-alphazero-11x11-lr0p0003-rc500k-ep100-cnn5x48.sav stays in saves/.
